answers.core: Having an HID API built into Godot could pave the way for users to create add-ons that extend support for specific HID devices through custom-built APIs. For example, users could make an API for interfacing nicely with the DualSense controller, or with the Switch Joy-Cons. Without the underlying HID API being built in, these controller extensions would have to bring their own solution such as hidapi.
answers.workaround: No, I would expect it to take a fair amount of work.
